notes:
Important fix for DS games and the Gen1Recomp port, plus controller fixes.

If your console only ever updates over the air, DS games and the Gen1Recomp port would
not start at all on 2.34.3. Nothing happened when you launched them. The update package
is built on Windows, which cannot mark a file as runnable on Linux, so both engines
arrived without permission to run. They are marked correctly now, both at launch time
and by the boot installer, so this cannot happen to a future engine either.

DraStic's own menu no longer flashes in front of the SCCM pause menu. After the first
pause it appeared in front every time, and your controller drove it instead of the
SCCM menu.

PPSSPP again works with a controller that was never taken through controller setup. In
2.34.3 the port 1 change could leave PPSSPP with no usable controller at all if the pad
you assigned to port 1 had not been set up. Which pads an emulator can see is now based
on what the system actually reports, so a controller you never set up cannot take the
slot from one you did.

If your controller still does not work in PPSSPP, that one is not fixed yet, but a
report from your console is now worth far more: the debug report includes what PPSSPP
and DraStic saw of your controllers. Please send a fresh one from Settings.
